title: Deliver Iron Ore to Gintfield Steel Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Iron Ore** delivered to **Gintfield Steel Mill** (industry id 15, near tile 110,55).

A likely supplier is **Lardham Iron Ore Mine** (industry id 9, near tile 89,71); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
